digest.component_or_area: author guides and user documentation for plan-review gate
propositions: Author guides currently describe a split between Success Criteria (containers) and Acceptance Criteria (leaves) that no longer exists after the epic's vocabulary collapse.

The prose in src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md lines 58–76 instructs authors to write headings that the new gate does not read and must be rewritten to describe containers by their actual distinguishing requirement: child decomposition covering acceptance criteria, not by SC vocabulary.
The user docs at docs/user-guide.md:219–230 and docs/llm-framework.md:407 contain SC vocabulary that must be removed and restated to reflect the collapsed vocabulary.

After rewrite, the guides must still communicate that containers differ from leaves by requiring child decomposition and deferral of testing to children, not by the presence or absence of a heading name.
Four permanent carve-outs in src/rebar/llm/ must remain untouched despite containing SC vocabulary, as they serve non-heading purposes or are part of deferred epic scope.
